meta.name: implement-legal-reform
meta.description: Use when implementing comprehensive legal, agricultural, or military reforms in a stagnating state. Based on Shang Yang's reforms in Qin, covers public talent recruitment, reform debate, equal law enforcement, and institutionalization of merit-based systems.

copy.tagline: 模拟商鞅变法，推动国家制度改革
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果对历史改革策略感兴趣并想模拟制度变革
copy.tagline_en: Simulate Shang Yang's reforms to drive institutional change
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are interested in historical reform strategies and want to simulate institutional change

howto.what: Claude会执行一套法律改革步骤：评估国家弱点、公开招募人才、辩论改革方案、实施法律/农业/军事改革、平等执法、经过调整期后制度化。
howto.when: 当用户说要对一个停滞的国家实施全面的法律、农业或军事改革时触发。

say.text: 请为我的王国设计一套类似商鞅变法的改革方案。
我们国家法律不公，该如何改革？
say.note: Claude会聚焦法律平等执法步骤。

say.text: 如何通过奖励农业和军功来振兴国力？
say.note: Claude会实施农业与军事激励措施。

howto.what_en: Claude executes a legal reform procedure: assess state weaknesses, issue public call for talent, debate reform proposals, implement core reforms (legal/agricultural/military), enforce laws equally, allow adjustment period, and institutionalize changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says they want to implement comprehensive legal, agricultural, or military reforms in a stagnating state.

say_en.text: Design a reform plan for my kingdom similar to Shang Yang's reforms.
say_en.note: Claude will run the full reform process.

say_en.text: Our country's laws are unfair, how to reform?
say_en.note: Claude will focus on equal law enforcement.

say_en.text: How to revitalize the nation by rewarding agriculture and military merit?
say_en.note: Claude will implement agriculture and military incentives.
